changeSet.comment: Resident profile for the field officer: occupation and workplace columns, and the existing notes column exposed through the tc2_roster.resident view (appended columns, so existing readers and the audit trigger keep working).

changeSet.author: claude
changeSet.comment: Shared attachment metadata. File bytes live in the server attachment folder (application.attachments.root) under a random storage key; they are only served through the API after the owner's territory check. Starts with resident portraits; later stages add owner kinds.
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE attachment ( id uuid PRIMARY KEY, owner_kind varchar(30) NOT NULL CHECK (owner_kind IN ('RESIDENT')), owner_id uuid NOT NULL, hamlet_id bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES hamlet(id), category varchar(30) NOT NULL, mime varchar(50) NOT NULL CHECK (mime IN ('image/jpeg','image/png','application/pdf')), storage_key varchar(64) NOT NULL UNIQUE, size_bytes bigint NOT NULL CHECK (size_bytes > 0), sha256 char(64) NOT NULL, caption varchar(500) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', is_primary boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false, created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), created_by varchar(255) NOT NULL, created_by_subject varchar(255) NOT NULL ); CREATE INDEX ix_attachment_owner ON attachment(owner_kind, owner_id, created_at DESC); CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ux_attachment_primary ON attachment(owner_kind, owner_id) WHERE is_primary; COMMENT ON TABLE attachment IS 'Attachment metadata; bytes stored on the server filesystem under storage_key';
